summary: 2026 UCI Women's WorldTeam. UCI registration keeps 'zondacrypto' but both Cyclist (2026-07-14) and The Inner Ring (2026-08-05) report zondacrypto was dropped mid-2026 and the team races as Canyon-SRAM.
